_comment: Calibrated against the Deck Edit screen's 'Card Inventory' sidebar (NOT a dedicated full-screen card list) at 2560x1440. Tied to this exact resolution and this exact panel -- re-measure if either differs. Card name is the stylized text baked into the card art itself, so accuracy will be lower than a clean UI label would give; the copy-count digit's bounding box deliberately overlaps into the next column, matching how the game actually renders it.
